source_refs.note: Topic 26.2 with Quick Check 26.1, answered (PDF 150-151); the schemes are redrawn and the skateboard photograph is described. The book's '1,4-hexanedioic acid' is given as hexanedioic (hexane-1,6-dioic) acid. Answers need review.

blocks.text: Nylon is a synthetic polyamide, formed by condensation polymerisation, usually from two different monomers: a diamine, H2N-R-NH2, and a dicarboxylic acid, HOOC-R'-COOH; a small molecule, usually water, is removed. Nylon-6,6 is the most common example: it is made from 1,6-diaminohexane and 1,4-hexanedioic acid: n H2N-(CH2)6-NH2 + n HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH -> [-NH-(CH2)6-NH-CO-(CH2)4-CO-]n + 2n H2O.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: Adipic acid, HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH, is hexanedioic acid (hexane-1,6-dioic acid): its two COOH carbons are C1 and C6, not 1,4.

blocks.alt: Top row: H2N-(CH2)6-NH2, HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH, H2N-(CH2)6-NH2, HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH, each drawn with its N-H, C=O and OH bonds. An arrow leads to a chain ...-NH-(CH2)6-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)4-C(=O)-NH-(CH2)6-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)4-C(=O)-..., the first unit in magenta, with +H2O under each of the four C=O groups.
blocks.caption: Preparation of nylon-6,6 (original drawing after the textbook's unnumbered figure on PDF page 150).

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The printed nylon-6,6 chain leaves out the bond between the third N and the (CH2)6 group; it is drawn joined above.

Nylon-6 is formed from a single monomer, caprolactam, which has a cyclic structure; it is named nylon-6 because the monomer has six carbon atoms. The ring opens to give [-NH-(CH2)5-CO-]n. The reaction is not a typical condensation, because no small molecule is removed, but nylon-6 is classed as a condensation polymer because of the way its amide links form. Nylon-6 gives a smoother surface and higher impact resistance than nylon-6,6, and it is easier to mould because its melting point is lower; it is used in rollers, skateboard wheels and power-tool handles.

blocks.alt: Three caprolactam rings, each a seven-membered ring of C(=O), N(H) and five CH2 groups. An arrow leads to the chain ...C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH..., the last unit in green, labelled Nylon 6.
blocks.caption: Formation of nylon-6 from caprolactam (original drawing after the textbook's unnumbered figure on PDF page 150).

items: The repeating unit of nylon-6,10 is -NH-(CH2)6-NH-CO-(CH2)8-CO-. What are its monomers?
The monomers of nylon-6,4 are H2N(CH2)6NH2 and HOOC(CH2)2COOH. Give the repeating unit.
